chunks.description_en: The first-person viewpoint fires the Five-SeveN repeatedly in a wide industrial corridor with yellow structural columns and red barrels, strafing left and right while an HE Grenade detonates nearby.
chunks.description_zh: 第一人称视角在宽阔工业走廊内持Five-SeveN连续射击，黄色结构柱与红色油桶清晰可见，同时左右横移，附近一枚HE手雷爆炸。
chunks.view_change: slight right yaw revealing more of the corridor's right wall and yellow column
environment_focus: wide concrete floor with yellow lane markings

chunks.description_en: Continued Five-SeveN fire bursts while standing still then briefly strafing, with a duck-down crouch beginning near the end, inside the same industrial corridor flanked by yellow columns and red barrels.
chunks.description_zh: 持续以Five-SeveN连射，先静止后短暂横移，接近结束时开始下蹲，场景仍为黄色立柱与红色油桶夹道的工业走廊。
chunks.view_change: right yaw and pitch up then down, keeping corridor center in view

chunks.description_en: The first-person viewpoint completes the final Five-SeveN shots while crouched then stands back up, strafing forward-left through the industrial corridor past yellow columns and stacked red barrels.
chunks.description_zh: 第一人称视角完成最后几发Five-SeveN射击后从蹲姿起身，向左前方横移穿过工业走廊，经过黄色立柱与堆叠红色油桶。
chunks.view_change: left yaw and pitch up revealing more of the corridor's left side and ceiling fixtures

chunks.description_en: No firing; the first-person viewpoint moves forward-left then left through the industrial corridor, the view sweeping left to reveal a wider section with shipping containers, green wall panels, and a 'B' site marker.
chunks.description_zh: 无射击；第一人称视角向左前方及左侧移动，视角左转，显露出更宽阔区域，可见集装箱、绿色墙板及'B'点标识。
chunks.view_change: sustained left yaw revealing shipping containers and wider corridor section with 'B' signage
environment_focus: concrete floor with yellow lane lines

chunks.description_en: The first-person viewpoint moves forward while the view pitches down and sweeps right then left, revealing a fallen player model and blood decals on the concrete floor near red barrels and a yellow column base.
chunks.description_zh: 第一人称视角向前移动，视角下俯并向右后向左扫动，地面可见倒下的玩家模型与血迹，周围有红色油桶与黄色立柱底座。
chunks.movement: mixed movement (left strafe -> forward-left strafe -> forward)
chunks.view_change: pitch down and right then left yaw revealing fallen player model and blood decals on floor
environment_focus: fallen player model on concrete floor
blood decals near yellow column base

subject_list.subject_attribute: Gloved hands visible gripping a Five-SeveN pistol held at screen-right lower quadrant in a standard two-handed ready stance; CT side; pink-sleeved arms partially visible at frame edges.

environment_detail.area_or_callout: wide interior industrial corridor, consistent with de_nuke's lower or outer service area
environment_detail.opening_view: A wide industrial corridor fills the frame at roughly eye height; the horizon sits at mid-screen. Dominant geometry: a broad concrete floor with bold yellow painted lane lines running left-to-right, yellow-painted heavy structural steel columns at screen-left and center, and green corrugated metal wall panels with a white 'B' label sign at screen-right background. Red cylindrical barrels are stacked against the right wall in the midground. The ceiling is high with exposed fluorescent strip lighting.
environment_detail.layout_and_sightlines: The corridor is wide enough for multiple players abreast, running roughly left-to-right across the frame. Yellow columns create partial cover at regular intervals. The right wall is lined with stacked red barrels and green panels. A secondary lane or doorway is suggested at the far background left. Sightlines extend deep into the corridor; no smoke or obstruction blocks the main lane during the firing phase. Later the view reveals a wider section with large shipping containers along the right wall.
environment_detail.surfaces_and_materials: Concrete floor with yellow painted stripes; yellow-painted heavy steel structural columns with black hazard banding; green corrugated metal wall panels; red metal cylindrical barrels; white plaster or metal ceiling with fluorescent tube fixtures; gray shipping container surfaces visible in later frames.
environment_detail.props_and_interactables: Stacked red barrels along right wall; yellow structural columns at regular intervals; 'B' site marker sign on green wall panel; large gray shipping containers visible in mid-to-late clip; fallen player model with blood decals visible on floor in final frames.
environment_detail.lighting_and_visibility: Indoor artificial lighting from overhead fluorescent strips; even soft illumination with mild shadows cast by columns; no fog or smoke; muzzle flash visible during firing phase producing brief bright orange-yellow light at screen-right; no persistent smoke or fire effects.
environment_detail.hud_and_overlay: Standard CS2 HUD visible: crosshair at screen center, radar at top-left, health and armor indicators at bottom-left, ammo counter at bottom-right showing Five-SeveN ammunition, weapon icon visible.
environment_detail.persistent_world_effects: HE Grenade detonation effect visible briefly near clip start; blood decals accumulate on floor in final frames near fallen player model.

segments.visual_description_long: A wide industrial corridor on de_nuke opens at eye height, dominated by a broad concrete floor with bold yellow lane markings, heavy yellow-painted steel columns at left and center, and green corrugated wall panels bearing a white 'B' sign at screen-right. Stacked red barrels line the right wall in the midground under bright fluorescent ceiling strips. A brief flash and debris cloud from an HE Grenade detonation appears near the left side early in the clip. The viewpoint shifts right then settles, keeping the yellow columns and red barrels in a clear corridor view. Later, <Camera1>the first-person view sweeps left and slightly upward, revealing a wider section of the corridor with large gray shipping containers along the right wall and additional yellow columns receding into the background.</Camera1> In the final seconds, <Camera2>the view pitches downward and pans right then left, bringing the concrete floor into focus where a fallen player model and blood decals are visible near a yellow column base and red barrels.</Camera2>

environment_detail.area_or_callout: 宽阔室内工业走廊，与de_nuke下层或外部服务区域一致
environment_detail.opening_view: 宽阔工业走廊以视线高度充满画面，地平线位于画面中部。主要几何结构：宽阔混凝土地面绘有醒目黄色车道线横贯左右，画面左侧与中央有黄色涂装重型钢结构立柱，画面右侧背景为带白色'B'标识的绿色波纹金属墙板。红色圆柱形油桶堆叠于右侧墙壁中景处。天花板高耸，装有裸露荧光灯管。
environment_detail.layout_and_sightlines: 走廊宽度可容纳多名玩家并排通行，大致横贯画面左右。黄色立柱在固定间距处提供部分掩护。右侧墙壁排列着堆叠红色油桶与绿色墙板。远景左侧隐约可见次级通道或门洞。射击阶段主通道视野开阔无遮挡。后期视角转动后可见右侧墙壁沿线有大型集装箱。
environment_detail.surfaces_and_materials: 绘有黄色条纹的混凝土地面；黄色涂装带黑色警示条纹的重型钢结构立柱；绿色波纹金属墙板；红色金属圆柱形油桶；带荧光灯管的白色或金属天花板；后期画面可见灰色集装箱表面。
environment_detail.props_and_interactables: 右侧墙壁堆叠红色油桶；固定间距黄色结构立柱；绿色墙板上的'B'点标识牌；中后期可见大型灰色集装箱；最后几帧地面可见倒下的玩家模型与血迹。
environment_detail.lighting_and_visibility: 室内顶部荧光灯管提供人工照明；均匀柔和光线，立柱投下轻微阴影；无烟雾或浓烟；射击阶段画面右侧可见短暂橙黄色枪口火焰；无持续烟雾或火焰效果。
environment_detail.hud_and_overlay: 标准CS2 HUD可见：画面中央准星，左上角雷达，左下角生命值与护甲指示，右下角Five-SeveN弹药计数器与武器图标。
environment_detail.persistent_world_effects: 片段开始时附近可见HE手雷爆炸效果；最后几帧倒下玩家模型附近地面积累血迹。

segments.visual_description_long: de_nuke一条宽阔工业走廊以视线高度展开，宽阔混凝土地面绘有醒目黄色车道线，左侧与中央矗立黄色涂装重型钢柱，画面右侧绿色波纹墙板上标有白色'B'字样。中景右侧墙壁堆叠红色油桶，头顶荧光灯管提供明亮均匀照明。片段初期左侧附近出现HE手雷爆炸产生的短暂闪光与碎片云。视角随后向右调整并稳定，黄色立柱与红色油桶保持在清晰的走廊视野中。随后，<Camera1>第一人称视角向左并略微上扬，显露走廊更宽阔区段，右侧墙壁可见大型灰色集装箱，黄色立柱向远景延伸。</Camera1>最后数秒，<Camera2>视角向下俯仰并先右后左横扫，混凝土地面进入焦点，黄色立柱底座与红色油桶旁可见倒下的玩家模型与血迹。</Camera2>
